title: Ordinary inverse base-change pasting with fixed comparisons
statement: Let X,Y,Y′,Z be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, f:X→Y a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, g:Y′→Y and h:Z→Y′ arbitrary morphisms. Fix the derived O-module categories and their full QCoh subcategories [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullbacks and direct images [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image], and QCoh preservation [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Put P=(X×_Y Y′)×_{Y′}Z, Q=X×_Y Z, e:P≅Q, p:P→Z, q:Q→Z, u:Q→X, v₁:X×_Y Y′→X, v₂:P→X×_Y Y′ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let L and R denote the restricted pullback and direct-image functors. Use the pinned composition family and adjunctions [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition, def-pc-derived-base-change-map], and the fixed comparisons [lem-sc-horizontal-duality-mate-comparisons]. Let s:L(v₁)⋙L(v₂)≅L(u)⋙L(e) be composition followed by the first projection equation and inverse composition, and b:L(g)⋙L(h)≅L(h≫g) the base composition comparison. Let ev be horizontalMateEquivalence e, ri:R(e)≅L(e.inv) its right-adjoint uniqueness comparison, and li:R(p)≅L(e.inv)⋙R(q) be the second projection equation followed by horizontalMatePushComp e.hom q and ri whiskered by R(q). For each E∈D_QCoh(X) define π_E=li.hom_(L(e)L(u)E)≫R(q)(ev.unitIso.inv_(L(u)E)). Assume the three ordinary base-change transformations are componentwise isomorphisms on QCoh complexes. Write τ for the inverse outer square and σ for the horizontal paste of the two inverse ordinary squares. Then R(p)(s.hom_E) ≫ π_E ≫ τ_E = σ_E ≫ b.hom_(R(f)E). This equation has no supplied right adjoints to R(p) or R(q), and no mate of their uniqueness comparison.

proof.text: Apply horizontal_ordinary_forward_fixed_pasting to the explicitly constructed upper comparison and transfer square, with their defining equalities. This supplies bβ=γAk before any invertibility assumption.

Reflect the three ordinary component isomorphisms through the fully faithful QCoh inclusions. The private qc_inverse_cancel lemma gives both inverse equations for each qcInverseBaseChange component. The horizontal component formula, functoriality of composition, and the two inner inverse equations give σγ=id; the outer inverse equation gives βτ=id.

Multiply bβ=γAk on the left by σ and on the right by τ. The equations σγ=id and βτ=id give Akτ=σb. The categorical identity for pasting with an identity bottom functor identifies kτ with (τ≫ₕk).app, yielding the stated equation.

theorem horizontal_ordinary_inverse_fixed_pasting
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y')
    (hβh : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) (h ≫ g)
        (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβ₂ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g),
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h) pullback.condition E.obj)) :
    letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f (h ≫ g) : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))
    letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let s := horizontalOrdinaryUpperComparison f g h
    let e := pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g h
    let q := pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)
    let p := pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h
    let k := horizontalOrdinaryTransfer e q p (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd f g h)
    let τ := qcInverseBaseChange f (h ≫ g) hβh
    let σ := qcInverseBaseChange f g hβ ≫ₕ
      @qcInverseBaseChange _ (pullback f g) Y' Z _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h hβ₂
    ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      (qcDirectImage (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)).map
          (s.hom.app E) ≫ (τ ≫ₕ k).app E =
        σ.app E ≫ (horizontalOrdinaryBaseComparison g h).hom.app
          ((qcDirectImage f).obj E)
